assertions.subject: Cytomegalovirus disease
assertions.quote: The mainstay of CMV esophagitis treatment is ganciclovir and valganciclovir.

assertions.subject: Cytomegalovirus disease
assertions.quote: The treatment of active disease should begin with induction therapy using IV ganciclovir

assertions.subject: Cytomegalovirus disease
assertions.quote: Maintenance therapy with IV ganciclovir at 5 mg/kg/d is indicated in cases with concurrent retinitis or recurrent GI disease

assertions.subject: Cytomegalovirus disease
assertions.quote: Relapse is unfortunately common, as the patients have a baseline, severely persistent immune deficiency most of the time, and treatment only suppresses the infection but does not eliminate it.

assertions.subject: Cytomegalovirus disease
assertions.quote: Foscarnet is an alternative to ganciclovir in cases where resistance to the first-line treatment occurs.

assertions.subject: Cytomegalovirus colitis
assertions.quote: The majority of immunocompetent patients with CMV colitis may require no treatment with antiviral medications.

assertions.subject: Cytomegalovirus colitis
assertions.quote: In these cases, ganciclovir or valganciclovir may be considered for treatment.
